fact.en: Thinking Kanvas held a vast empire: They were restricted to Magadha and parts of Central India, unlike the Mauryas.
fact.hi: Thinking Kanvas held a vast empire: They were restricted to Magadha and parts of Central India, unlike the Mauryas.

fact.en: Confusing Kanvas with the Kushanas: Kanvas were indigenous Brahminical rulers, while Kushanas were foreign invaders.
